species.real: In 2019 a lost Lewis chess piece, bought for £5 in 1964 and kept in a drawer in Edinburgh, sold at auction for £735,000.
species.name: Shieldbiter

dex.text: A stout ivory warrior in a nasal helm, with its teeth clamped on the rim of its shield and the look of someone who has just won an argument with the board. It is not angry. It has simply lost its temper, quite deliberately, for the duration.
dex.fact: The Lewis Chessmen are 93 pieces carved in walrus ivory and whale tooth, found in 1831 in a sandbank at Uig on the Isle of Lewis and probably made in Norway in the 1100s. The rooks are carved as berserkers biting their shields.
